qa.what_happened: The study ended early, which was unexpected. I was told the debrief was to understand how the experience felt and to reflect on the impact of the silent conditions.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, it was really me experiencing everything described.

qa.what_happened: The study was stopped early, and I was in my cell at lights out, reflecting on the six days that passed.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, it was really me in the role of Prisoner 6957.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: No, but it resembles studies like 'The Stanford Prison Experiment' in terms of its setup and goals.

qa.what_happened: The study was stopped early, and I had my private debrief with the lead researcher. During the final moments, the tension and exhaustion were at their peak. The guards were particularly strict, ensuring complete silence and obedience.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Prisoner 7155.

qa.what_happened: The study ended early due to my increasing inability to maintain the facade of authority and the prisoners' growing sense of despair and disconnection.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me speaking as Officer Lang, enforcing the rules and feeling conflicted about the situation.

qa.what_happened: Today was uneventful in terms of incidents, but the enforced silence and strict adherence to rules continued to take a toll on me. The monotony of the task made me question my identity within this role.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me acting as Officer Doyle.

qa.what_happened: The study had become increasingly oppressive, with prisoners maintaining strict silence throughout all activities. The tension was high, and the lead researcher, Officer Lang, emphasized complete obedience, pushing the boundaries of the original rules.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. The environment became suffocating, and I found myself enforcing the rules more strictly out of a mix of fear and a desire to exert control.
